entries.2ba8545428094518: The company sets out as the theme of its medium- to long-term strategy "realizing measured growth through sustainable management of each group business" and states that it will execute five policies: innovation in the Japanese market and creation of sustainable revenue, improvement of brand value, acceleration of diversification of human resources and organization, strengthening competitiveness through acceleration of diversification of research and development, production, and logistics, and promotion of management that can respond to change. It states that, as issues to be addressed on a priority basis, it will respond to changes and diversification in the markets for its main businesses, cosmetics and pharmaceuticals and food, and work on improving brand value and strengthening competitiveness in research and development, production, and logistics.
